BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   C. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

3. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   C. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   D. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   C. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.

5. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.

6. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   B. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.

7. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   B. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   B. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   B. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   D. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

11. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

14. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

15. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   B. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Procurement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
